name: The Deep Lantern
role: Busan sea gate boss; hushed Far Side sea hero and living lighthouse
height: No fixed standing height;150m long whale-like leviathan. Crest rises30m above the head.

palette.coral_cage: pale bone-white; no exact hex specified

locks: Old noble female leviathan; broad blunt whale head, small ancient eyes, wide closed mouth; never cute or a horror face.
One long whale-like body tapering to a broad whale tail; no hind limbs.
Exactly two forelimb webbed hands; four long fingers and one opposing thumb each,15m across.
Grey-blue matte hide crusted with coral, barnacles and kelp.
Rusted industrial lid plates stuck in her dorsal hide like overlapping scales.
One curved crest-spine from top of head, rising30m, carrying one12m bone-white coral-cage lantern.
Hushed: violet core, dull-violet eyes and central brow fissure leaking sparse violet ash; solid face, no face-hole.
Freed: pure-white lighthouse light, gentle sea-grey eyes, inactive brow scar.
Damaged lantern: exactly three front coral bars shattered, paired upper/lower stubs.
